main_measure.name: mean 6-bar excess return (return minus coin's normal 6-bar drift) over bet cases
main_measure.threshold: t >= 2 over at least 30 cases pooled (confirm, with positive slope); t <= -2 over at least 30 cases (reject)

supporting_check.name: slope of excess 6-bar return on forecast, grid bars with forecast > 0

decided_by: Mean excess return t >= 2 over at least 30 pooled cases and the supporting slope is positive.
reading: A case is the first long bet (forecast rise >= 2 from its low since the last bet, reset at flat) in each 6-bar grid cell counted from each window's first row, the drift is each coin's mean non-overlapping 6-bar return over all its windows, and the slope is an ordinary least-squares slope on the grid bars with forecast > 0 and a full 6-bar return inside the window.
